description: This file defines the Lookup class for implementing lookup functions within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for searching and retrieving data from arrays or cell ranges, including validation, transposition, and lookup operations used in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Defines lookup functions, primarily the 'lookup' method, for searching data within spreadsheet ranges and arrays.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup operation to find a value in a range or array, with support for transposing ranges and handling different data orientations.

methods.name: verifyLookupValues
methods.description: Validates and adjusts lookup vector values to ensure correct matching behavior.

methods.name: verifyResultVector
methods.description: Ensures the result vector has the correct orientation (row or column) for returning data.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a data array.

methods.name: columnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a data array.
